policies.policy: advanced MCP write helpers must be removed or explicitly unsafe
backend barrel must not export raw identity-forwarding primitives
MCP barrel must not export tool-local safety stamping
production-copyable app surfaces must use Trellis caller helpers, not raw forwarding envelopes
beginner function reference must teach operation.* from @lupinum/trellis/app
beginner app setup must import defineTrellis from @lupinum/trellis/app
beginner personal auth identity must use defineAppIdentity.fromAuth
boolean delegation is banned; use backend-revalidated delegation evidence
maintained example tests must use Trellis test principals, not raw Convex identity
maintained example tests must use Trellis test principals, not raw forwarding envelopes
generic cross-tenant escape hatches are banned; use named crossTenant capabilities
global public read tables are banned; use handler-local `reads`
`identityForwardingFunctionRef` is banned; use handler `id` or operation `executeFunctionRef`
MCP authoring surfaces must import operation ref helpers from @lupinum/trellis/mcp
`guard: open` is banned in protected lanes
access context handlers must use query.session, not public reads
public agency/demo seed mutations are banned
public MCP email resolvers are banned
shared-secret and route-side webhook idempotency helpers are banned from production-copyable surfaces
raw stringly trusted auth is banned; use verifier-produced proof objects
tool-local MCP safety stamping is banned
server barrel must not export boolean delegation
server barrel must not export shared-secret or route-side webhook idempotency helpers
